messages:
maya: T-24h for the 2.4.0 cutoff — kicking off a quick green sweep. If your PR needs a last-minute bump/changelog entry, pls flag now.
ade: quick CI snapshot: overall build green at 96% but integration-db has 3 failures over the last hour, likely network timeouts. cc @infra
sam: saw two flakes in group-store e2e (timeout on setup). Logs show `ConnectionResetError` to redis for ~200ms.
jen: autoscaler reported one builder node with high iowait earlier — I drained it and restarted the runner. Re-runs in progress.
luca: rerunning the failing suites now with `./ci/retry_failed.sh --parallel 4`. Will post results in 10m.
ade: thanks @luca — also noticed the changelog generator missed one entry for the metrics PR. Maya: can you confirm the changelog snippet?
maya: added the metric change in `CHANGELOG.md` (small bullet). Pushed to branch.
sam: reruns show group-store passes now. One remaining flaky in `auth-service` smoke that times out on DB migration step.
jen: if it's the migration timeout we can increase timeout temporarily for the preflight job — up for a quick patch?
luca: recommend instead to backfill a short wait in the migration script (`sleep 2`) — lower blast radius. I can open a tiny PR.
maya: do it. We want no behavior changes, just stabilizer.
jen: infra note: autoscaler is healthy after the drain, but builder queue length spiked ~3m ago. Recommend throttling some non-blocking nightlies for the next 2 hours.
ade: creatin g a temporary hold: moving nightly -> low priority.
deploy-bot: Deploy window scheduled at T-2h for canary runs. Will only proceed if green sweep remains >=95% and no critical flakes.
qa-bot: Current flaky count: 4 transient; 2 are marked priority-high (auth-service, integration-db).
sam: I'll triage auth-service now, patch incoming shortly.
luca: reruns back to 99% green after small fixes. Keeping watch for any recurrence.
maya: awesome. Final asks before cutoff: 1) confirm changelog entries (done), 2) PRs merged to release branch (ping reviewers), 3) freeze non-essential nightlies.
jen: reviewers pinged for 3 outstanding PRs.
ade: merging small stabilizer PRs once tests pass.
maya: thanks team — if anything blocks, drop it here and we can decide rollback vs. hotfix. :rocket:
